note: Missouri River bottomland area northwest of Corning, bought by the Corps of Engineers for river mitigation and managed by MDC beside Deroin Bend. Camping is allowed only at the three spots marked on the area map, each a gravel parking lot: this one on the county-line gravel road west of Highway 111, another 2.3 km farther west on the same road, and a third off the gravel lane south of Route 110 near Corning. No privy or water. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups. Three camping points, each paired with a lot and a P + camp symbol on the 8/10/2023 map: 484 = pin (county-line road by Kettle Ave), 1041 2.3 km W on the same road, 483 2.2 km SE off a lane south of Rt 110. All open gravel aprons a 23-ft rig fits. Pin ~15 m from the apron, fine. Split proposed for the SE spot only. Not waterfront kept (the river is 2 km+ away). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map. Camping is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' The 8/10/2023 map shows three 'Parking Lot' + 'Primitive Camping' symbol pairs on Corning CA. Imagery: each is a gravel apron ~25-40 m across off a gravel county road, enough for a 23-ft rig; no crossing or 4WD. No privy symbol anywhere.

CLUSTERS (3): (a) pin, GIS 484/lot 3117, 40.2637,-95.4749, on the Atchison/Holt county-line gravel road just west of Kettle Ave/Hwy 111. (b) GIS 1041/lot 7379, 40.2644,-95.5018, 2.3 km W on the same county-line road (map symbol by J Ave). On imagery it's a broad bare gravel/fill yard with equipment trailers parked at its south edge, possibly Corps mitigation work at capture time, so its current state is uncertain. Same road, so no split proposed. (c) GIS 483/lot 3115, 40.2455,-95.4651, 2.2 km SE, a gravel apron at the end of a lane running south from Route 110 / the Corning road, its own road and entrance.

SPLIT proposed (1): 'Corning Conservation Area - South Camping Area' at 40.2456,-95.4652 (on lot 3115), state/MDC, same groups, phone 816-271-3100, not waterfront (Missouri River ~1.3 km SW across fields and levee). Reach: from Corning, west on Route 110 / CR 110, then the gravel lane south to the lot (map).
PIN: stored 40.26371,-95.47493 sits ~15 m SE of lot 3117's gravel apron (40.26387,-95.47518). Optional move to 40.2639,-95.4752.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the camping lots sit in crop fields and grassland 2 km+ from the Missouri River behind the levee; no water nearby.
